name: Above Lock
description: Windows MDM settings in the Above Lock category, applied as OMA-URI (SyncML) values.

properties.name: Allow Cortana Above Lock
properties.description: Added in Windows 10, version 1607. Specifies whether or not the user can interact with Cortana using speech while the system is locked. If you allow or don’t configure this setting, the user can interact with Cortana using speech while the system is locked. If you block this setting, the system will need to be unlocked for the user to interact with Cortana using speech.

properties.name: Allow Toasts
properties.description: Specifies whether to allow toast notifications above the device lock screen. Most restrictive value is "Block".

properties.name: Configure Audio On Lock Screen
properties.description: This policy will allow the audio above lock screen to be managed by IT admins and allow apps like digital signage to play audio above lock screen without having a user signed on.

enum.description: No audio playback or recording on lock screen (aside from OS defined exceptions).
Audio playback allowed on lock screen. Audio recording is not allowed.
Audio playback and recording allowed on lock screen.
